# DeepL MCP

Translate text and documents, improve writing, and discover supported languages through DeepL’s provider-hosted MCP server.

Category: Developer. Connect from any WhatEverFi bot at https://whateverfi.com/integrations/deepl-mcp/.

## Actions

- **Correct-text** (read-only): Correct one or more texts for typos, grammar and punctuation errors using DeepL.
- **Download-document** (read-only): Get a download link for a translated document once its status is 'done'.
- **Get-document-status** (read-only): Check the translation status of a document session.
- **Get-source-languages** (read-only): Get the source language codes supported by DeepL for translation, e.g.
- **Get-target-languages** (read-only): Get the target language codes supported by DeepL for translation, e.g.
- **Rephrase-text** (read-only): Rephrase text in the same or a different language using DeepL.
- **Translate-text** (read-only): Translate text to one or more target languages using DeepL.
- **Upload-document**: Translate a whole file or document, preserving its original layout and formatting.
- **Upload-document-show-fallback-widget** (read-only): Second step of a document translation, for when the file bytes cannot be sent to 'uploadUrl'.
